The WiX Toolset v3.11.2.4516 files in this directory are unmodified binaries
from the WiX Toolset v3.11.2 distribution (tag `wix3112rtm`). They are used
only to extract Embercrown's bundled MSI so the install directory can be kept
when Cinderport updates an existing copy.

Source code: https://github.com/wixtoolset/wix3/tree/wix3112rtm
Release: https://github.com/wixtoolset/wix3/releases/tag/wix3112rtm
